dataset.paper: Pinkwart & Schwarz, Phys. Rev. D 98, 083536 (2018), arXiv:1803.07473
dataset.release: Planck 2015 / second public release full-mission cleaned maps

predictions.missing_vertex_reconstruction: choose projective signs so all three signed pairwise dots are negative when possible; s_rec=-sum(v_i)/norm(sum(v_i))

primary_numeric_residual.name: R_face
primary_numeric_residual.interpretation: zero is exact tetrahedral-face morphology; report numeric residual for every map

secondary_statistics: angular separation of s_rec from the already frozen CIR AoE axis

verdict_policy.formal_pass_fail: NOT_ASSIGNED because the repository files do not encode per-vector covariance and no null-calibrated R_face threshold is frozen
verdict_policy.allowed_language: EXACT_MATCH only if numerical precision gives all abs dots=1/3; otherwise report residual and cross-map stability, with NON_DECISIVE statistical verdict

forbidden: choose projective signs to minimize R_face; R_face is sign invariant
